absent: Enabled crash kexec execution, image loading and vmcoreinfo copying beyond inert fallbacks.
Real supplementary group storage, resizing, freeing and membership search.
LSM security blob layout and enforcement decisions.
Keyring lifecycle, joining and request authorization.
Seccomp filter evaluation beyond the permissive fallback.
Audit context allocation and syscall audit record contents.
User dispatch selection, ABI handling and rollback mechanics.
Tracer side effects on registers and system call numbers.
Tick, context tracking and interrupt state transitions.
Device RAM discovery, old memory access and crash reservation allocation.

findings.text: The macros KEXEC_CRASH_HP_NONE, KEXEC_CRASH_HP_ADD_CPU, KEXEC_CRASH_HP_REMOVE_CPU, KEXEC_CRASH_HP_ADD_MEMORY and KEXEC_CRASH_HP_REMOVE_MEMORY denote values zero through four in that order, while KEXEC_CRASH_HP_INVALID_CPU denotes an all ones unsigned marker.

In this configuration crash handling helpers named __crash_kexec, crash_kexec, kexec_should_crash, kexec_crash_loaded, crash_save_cpu, kimage_crash_copy_vmcoreinfo and crash_load_dm_crypt_keys are inert fallbacks that perform no action and report neutral success or negative presence outcomes.
The markers ELFCORE_ADDR_MAX and ELFCORE_ADDR_ERR denote reserved header addresses, with the maximum unsigned value meaning absent and the next lower value meaning erroneous.

The predicate vmcore_elf_check_arch_cross is always negative, vmcore_elf32_check_arch delegates to the generic architecture check, and vmcore_elf64_check_arch succeeds when either the generic check or the cross check succeeds.

One variant of is_kdump_kernel detects a kdump kernel by comparing elfcorehdr_addr against the absent marker while the other variant always reports false, is_vmcore_usable requires difference from both erroneous and absent markers, and vmcore_unusable forces the erroneous marker.
The structure vmcore_cb holds a predicate for testing page frame RAM membership, a hook for collecting device RAM extents into a list, and a list node for chaining.

The structure vmcore_range chains in a list and carries a physical address plus size plus file offset, vmcore_alloc_add_range appends a new zeroed entry and reports resource exhaustion on failure, and vmcore_free_ranges safely unlinks and releases each entry.
The structure vmcoredd_data carries a fixed size unique dump name plus a size plus a driver callback that fills a supplied buffer during collection.
In this configuration vmcore_add_device_dump and read_from_oldmem are unavailable and uniformly report operation not supported without side effects.

Crash CMA bookkeeping exposes CRASHK_CMA_RANGES_MAX as four with CRASHKERNEL_CMA and CRASHKERNEL_CMA_RANGES_MAX as aliases, while an alternate configuration defines crashk_cma_cnt and the ranges limit as zero.
The helper arch_add_crash_res_to_iomem uses a default affirmative policy for exposing crash resources to the I/O memory map.
Sizing exposes DEFAULT_CRASH_KERNEL_LOW_SIZE as one hundred twenty eight mebibytes, CRASH_ALIGN follows SZ_2M, CRASH_ADDR_LOW_MAX follows SZ_4G, and CRASH_ADDR_HIGH_MAX follows memblock_end_of_DRAM.
The helper reserve_crashkernel_generic accepts size plus base plus low size plus high placement inputs and performs no action in this fallback.
The structure group_info holds a reference count plus a group count plus a trailing array of group identifiers, with randomized layout.

Acquisition via get_group_info increments the reference count and returns the same object, release via put_group_info drops the count and frees only on last reference, groups_free is inert here, and in_group_p plus in_egroup_p plus groups_search always report success.

The structure cred holds usage, uid, gid, suid, sgid, euid, egid, fsuid, fsgid, securebits, cap_inheritable, cap_permitted, cap_effective, cap_bset, cap_ambient, optional keyring members and security pointer, user, user_ns, ucounts, group_info, and a union of non_rcu versus rcu, with randomized layout.
The helper kernel_cred exposes initial task credentials through a raw RCU dereference without acquiring a reference.

The check cap_ambient_invariant_ok requires ambient capabilities to remain within the intersection of permitted and inheritable sets, override_creds and revert_creds swap the current credential pointer, and scoped_with_creds plus scoped_with_kernel_creds automatically restore prior credentials on scope exit.

Credential lifetime uses an atomic usage count where get_cred_many and get_cred add references and mark RCU handling with null safely ignored, get_cred_rcu fails when the count is already zero, and put_cred_many plus put_cred subtract and destroy only on transition to zero.

Current credential access uses RCU protection with current_cred plus current_real_cred plus __task_cred plus get_current_cred for lookup, task remote reads hold RCU read lock across the copy, and helpers get_current_user plus get_current_groups plus task and current identity plus capability plus user plus counter accessors acquire references when ownership transfers, with one user namespace variant fixed to the initial namespace and paired snapshots for uid gid plus euid egid plus fsuid fsgid.

The flag _TIF_UPROBE defaults to zero, SYSCALL_WORK_ENTER combines seccomp with tracepoint plus trace plus emulation plus audit plus user dispatch plus restartable sequence slice handling, and SYSCALL_WORK_EXIT combines tracepoint plus trace plus audit plus user dispatch plus exit trap handling.

Entry tracing via syscall_trace_enter applies user dispatch first with power to suppress, then restartable sequence slice handling, then tracer interaction with power to suppress or emulate and refresh work, then a post tracer seccomp gate, followed by tracepoint and audit notifications, reporting whether to proceed.

Entry from user mode via syscall_enter_from_user_mode_work bypasses handling when no entry bits are set, otherwise invokes entry tracing and refreshes the system call number to observe tracer changes before deciding whether to proceed.

Randomized entry via enter_from_user_mode_randomize_stack adds stack offset randomization under instrumentation guards after standard entry, and syscall_enter_from_user_mode_randomize_stack additionally enables interrupts around work handling and reports its outcome.

Single step reporting via report_single_step is suppressed for emulated calls and otherwise follows the exit trap bit, exit tracer handling via arch_ptrace_report_syscall_exit plus ptrace_report_syscall_exit plus user_single_step_report either forces a trap signal with user origin and zero identity or reports a system call stop, and clear_siginfo zeroes signal info before use.

Exit handling via syscall_exit_work first honors consumed user dispatch rollback by skipping tracers, then performs audit exit plus optional tracepoint with return value plus tracer or single step notification as indicated by work bits.

Exit to user mode work via syscall_exit_to_user_mode_work validates kernel context, invokes WARN handling and re-enables interrupts when locking debug detects disabled interrupts, runs rseq_debug_syscall_return with static branch gating in one variant and as a no-op in another, and runs one time exit work exactly once when exit bits are set.
Full exit via syscall_exit_to_user_mode sequences exit work under instrumentation plus interrupt disable plus exit preparation plus transfer to user mode.

The marker ARCH_XFER_TO_GUEST_MODE_WORK defaults to zero and XFER_TO_GUEST_MODE_WORK covers rescheduling plus lazy rescheduling plus pending signals plus signal notification plus resume notification plus architecture additions.

Guest transfer via xfer_to_guest_mode_prepare invokes disabled interrupt assertion and readies tick handling, arch_xfer_to_guest_mode_handle_work reports no work by default, and xfer_to_guest_mode_work_pending plus __xfer_to_guest_mode_work_pending determine pending work by testing thread flags against the guest mask with an asserting wrapper and a raw predicate.
Headers use include guards LINUX_CRASH_DUMP_H plus LINUX_CRASH_RESERVE_H plus _LINUX_CRED_H plus __LINUX_ENTRYCOMMON_H plus __LINUX_ENTRYVIRT_H plus _LINUX_IPC_H to ensure single inclusion.

Tracer reporting via ptrace_report_syscall skips untraced tasks, delivers a trap notification with optional good flag augmentation to traced tasks and forwards any resulting signal to the current task, and denies continuation when a fatal signal is pending.
